library_construction_protocol: Lysates were clarified from sonicated nuclei and histone-DNA complexes were isolated with KDM3A or p-KDM3A antibody.The sonicated DNA fragments were purified as Input control. The PCR products corresponding to bp 250-450 were gel-purified, quantified and stored at -80°C until use for sequencing
